Data: Documents making up evidentiary record for a specific investigation and containing Personal Information. Record type(s) and content(s) will vary depending on the scope of the investigation.⁴
Retention Periods: 10 years following the closure of an investigation.
Remarks: Necessary because of multiple violations, and the need to understand doping practices and networks in time.

Data: Courses completed, dates of completion, final score, role as a learner (Athlete, coach, etc.).
Retention Periods: Until all other associated records are deleted or as long as active in sport, whichever is longer.
Remarks: These data are not sensitive. Necessary to understand learner pathway over time through different roles (e.g., youth to Athlete to coach). Could be relevant in an ADRV case in relation to level of fault.
